description: Contextual personal topic preference. A reference alone has no action. With Context on, neutral discussion, questions, quotations and criticism stay visible. Mild support warns in Balanced; stronger promotion redacts. Broad hides eligible unwanted expressions. Wider references require Broad. Original Gommage meme masks remain separate. Requires alpha12 or later.
